# `jouet rule gap`

- **Usage:** `jouet rule gap [--rule <NAME>] <TEXT>`

Record something a rule could not express, for `jouet share --idea`

jouet records on its own when a rule reads a `jouet` primitive that does not exist. This records a wish in your words: "I kept doing X; there is no primitive for Y".

## Arguments
- **`<TEXT>`** — What you wanted a rule to do, and what was missing

## Flags
- **`--rule <NAME>`** — The rule you were writing, if any
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
